title: The Fort in the Yard
lines: Ben and Pam make a fort in the yard.
It starts with a big box and a card.
The fort is dark in the back part.
Pam gets a jar and a short lamp.
Then a big dog jumps on the fort.
It drops flat and Pam is sad.
Ben starts the fort back up.
The dog naps in the dark part.

questions.ask: What did Ben and Pam make the fort from?
questions.listenFor: A big box and a card. The jar and lamp came after, for the dark part.

questions.ask: What made the fort drop flat?
questions.listenFor: The big dog jumped on it. Send them back to that line if they guess.

questions.ask: Do you think the dog helped or made a mess? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. He broke it, but he ended up napping in it.
